summary: Suncor Energy filed a Form 6-K announcing a routine earnings release schedule for its first quarter 2026 financial results, which will be published on May 5, 2026, followed by a webcast on May 6, 2026. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under the 1934 Act, with no special transaction, merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or other corporate event disclosed. No deal terms, premiums, advisors, or board recommendations are mentioned. This is a standard, non-event-specific periodic disclosure.
